title: Character Information in Language Models: A Prompt-Independent Word Store and a Late, Question-Driven Signal That Grows With Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.30094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear probes recover character properties of a word from a language model's hidden states, but a probe at the answer position cannot say whether the property was stored with the word or produced because the prompt asked for it. We separate the two with a word-position baseline: the same held-out-word probe applied to the query word's own tokens in a sentence that asks nothing. Across 16 open-weight models from seven families (0.6B--14B) and eleven character tasks, the word tokens encode \texttt{first\_letter}, \texttt{last\_letter} and \texttt{most\_frequent\_letter} above a word-only nuisance floor in all 16 models, and about 70\% of that signal is already present in the token embedding. Asking the question adds a second signal at the answer position. Its size grows with model scale for all four prompt-sensitive tasks (Holm-corrected permutation $p \leq 0.018$, also within model families), and the growth is confined to the late layers:

translated_title: 语言模型中的字符信息：独立于提示的词汇存储与随模型规模增长的后期问题驱动信号
translated_abstract: 线性探针能够从语言模型的隐藏状态中恢复词的字符属性，但位于答案位置的探针无法区分该属性是随词本身一同存储的，还是因为提示提出了要求才产生的。我们通过词位置基线将二者分离：将同一个基于留出词训练的探针应用于一个不包含任何提问的句子中查询词自身的词元。在来自七个模型家族的16个开放权重模型（0.6B–14B）和11个字符任务上，全部16个模型中的词元都在仅含词的干扰底线之上编码了首字母、尾字母和最频繁字母信息，且约70%的该信号已存在于词元嵌入之中。提出问题会在答案位置增加第二个信号。对于全部四个提示敏感任务，该信号的规模随模型规模的增长而增大（经Holm校正的置换检验 p ≤ 0.018，在单个模型家族内部同样成立），且这种增长仅局限于模型的后期层：
tldr: 本研究通过词位置基线方法将语言模型中词的字符信息分解为两部分——约70%的字符信息（如首字母、尾字母、最频繁字母）已独立于提示预先存储在词元嵌入中，其余部分则是在答案位置由问题驱动、随模型规模增长且局限于后期层的信号。
en_tdlr: Using a word-position baseline, this study shows that ~70% of a word's character information (first/last/most frequent letter) is stored in token embeddings independently of prompts, while the remaining question-driven signal emerges at late layers and grows with model scale.
